reason: Review amendment to the stuck-alarm ladder: request_ledger.py::_raise_stuck_alarm now catches and logs a raising L1 filing per entry, so one failed filing neither re-WARNs every heartbeat nor starves the other due entries; request_ledger.py::_ladder_alarm_number refuses an alarm number outside STUCK_ALARM_THRESHOLD_MULTIPLES with a named ValueError instead of a bare IndexError. Both are new behaviour, not a failed refactor.
